test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Farmaceutical."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"Pharmaceutical."** • The incorrect spelling in Option 4 is the use **"F"** instead of **"Ph."** • **"Pharmaceutical"** means connected with the production of medicines and drugs. (औषधियों और दवाओं के निर्माण से संबंधित) • **Example**: *She has a **pharmaceutical**__ company.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: "Philosophy"** is spelled correctly and refers to the study of fundamental questions about existence, reality, and values. (जीवन के अर्थ एवं मतों से संबंधित विचारों का अध्ययन; दर्शन-शास्‍त्र) • **Option 2: "Passive"** is spelled correctly and describes a person or thing that is not active or does not take action. (जो कोई प्रतिक्रिया, भावना या रुचि न दिखाए; निष्क्रिय) • **Option 3: "Horrendous"** is spelled correctly and means extremely unpleasant, shocking, or terrible. (बहुत बुरा या अप्रिय) 179:T68f, The correct answer is **"An unrealistic or unattainable goal."**
